verdict.rationale: Point-in-time restore and branching are a fair question for a database, so the axis applies. The only related evidence is a pricing-page line about exporting backups to your own cloud account. That is an adjacent backup feature, not documented restore or branching to any point within a retention window, so it earns no credit.

support.subject: As a platform-engineer, I can restore or branch the database to any point in time within the retention window to recover from bad writes
